notes.key_messages:
It is essential that candidates read each question carefully and ensure that they give their answer in the
required form. Some candidates seemed to not appreciate the meaning of ‘exact form’ and could be directed
to past mark schemes for guidance.
Use of the word ‘Hence’ implies that work done in the previous part or parts of the question is needed.
notes.general_comments:
Candidates who had prepared well for the examination were usually fairly successful. However, many
candidates did not gain any meaningful marks. There appeared to be no timing issues and candidates had
plenty of space in which to write their responses.
